kebab_example: aliyun dts start-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsf19100l21860000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartSynchronizationJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的id，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSynchronizationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to start the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑类型为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以启动反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
